description: This file contains functions and types related to model selection, normalization, and configuration within an AI agent framework. It manages model references, allowed models, default settings, and provider normalization, with integrations for external modules and logging.

methods.name: loadCliBackendRuntime
methods.description: Attempts to load the CLI backend runtime module from predefined candidates, returning the module or null.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Initializes and returns the subsystem logger for model selection.

methods.name: normalizeAliasKey
methods.description: Converts an alias string to a normalized lowercase trimmed key.

methods.name: modelKey
methods.description: Generates a model key using shared model key normalization.

methods.name: legacyModelKey
methods.description: Creates a legacy model key string if it differs from the canonical key.

methods.name: isCliProvider
methods.description: Checks if a provider is a CLI backend, considering runtime modules and configuration.

methods.name: normalizeProviderModelId
methods.description: Normalizes provider and model IDs, including runtime normalization fallback.

methods.name: normalizeModelRef
methods.description: Normalizes a provider and model into a ModelRef object, with optional plugin normalization.

methods.name: parseModelRef
methods.description: Parses a raw string into a ModelRef, considering default provider and normalization options.

methods.name: resolvePersistedModelRef
methods.description: Resolves a model reference from runtime, override, or default parameters.

methods.name: inferUniqueProviderFromConfiguredModels
methods.description: Infers a unique provider for a given model from configuration, or returns undefined.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistModelKey
methods.description: Resolves a raw string into a model key if allowed.

methods.name: buildConfiguredAllowlistKeys
methods.description: Builds a set of allowed model keys from configuration allowlist.

methods.name: buildModelAliasIndex
methods.description: Creates an index of model aliases and keys from configuration.

methods.name: resolveModelRefFromString
methods.description: Resolves a string into a ModelRef, considering aliases and normalization.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredModelRef
methods.description: Resolves the primary model reference based on configuration, with fallback and warnings.

methods.name: resolveDefaultModelForAgent
methods.description: Determines the default model reference for a specific agent, considering overrides.

methods.name: resolveAllowedFallbacks
methods.description: Returns fallback models allowed for a given configuration and agent.

methods.name: resolveSubagentConfiguredModelSelection
methods.description: Resolves the subagent's configured model selection.

methods.name: resolveSubagentSpawnModelSelection
methods.description: Resolves the model to spawn for a subagent, considering overrides and defaults.

methods.name: buildAllowedModelSet
methods.description: Builds a set of allowed models, catalog, and fallback models based on configuration.

methods.name: buildConfiguredModelCatalog
methods.description: Constructs a catalog of models from configuration data.

methods.name: getModelRefStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a model reference within the catalog and allowed set.

methods.name: resolveAllowedModelRef
methods.description: Resolves a model reference from a raw string, with validation against allowed models.

methods.name: resolveThinkingDefault
methods.description: Determines the default thinking level for a model, considering configuration and legacy keys.

methods.name: resolveReasoningDefault
methods.description: Determines whether reasoning is enabled by default for a model.

methods.name: resolveHooksGmailModel
methods.description: Resolves the Gmail hook model if configured.

methods.name: normalizeModelSelection
methods.description: Normalizes a model selection value to a string or undefined.
